headline: Fronts Stir as Strategic Base Ledger Turns Volatile
war_summary: The latest ledger shows a marked widening of the active front. Callums Cape has intensified from the previous edition, recording 11 ownership events in two hours and 25 in 24, with four Warden-held and three Colonial-held bases. Linn Mercy has also quickened, posting six events in two hours and 30 across the day; ten bases remain Colonial-held and one neutral. Weathered Expanse is active again, with three events in two hours and 33 in 24, while seven Warden bases and two neutral positions stand on its ledger. Godcrofts has newly erupted with seven events in two hours, all centered on Isawa, though its nine bases remain Colonial-held. Mooring County has opened into a fresh contest, registering five events in two hours amid heavy, accelerating casualties; Wardens hold 11 of 12 bases. Elsewhere, Nevish Line has recorded no event in the latest two hours but still leads the day’s tally at 45, while Marban Hollow and Callahans Passage have gone quiet in the immediate window after earlier churn. The broad war remains unsettled, but the sharpest near-term movement is concentrated in these six sectors.
